summary: Chicago area resident, former system administrator for a marketing company, experienced in electronics and machining, specifically bevel gear production, programming background in Turbo Pascal and Delphi, currently learning Lazarus/Free Pascal, strong interest in capability-based security and multilevel secure systems, engaged in DIY electronics and software-defined radio, has a child, expresses concern about long-term health effects of COVID-19, advocates for open-source software and decentralized social networks, critical of current operating systems' security models, enjoys discussing technical topics related to programming, electronics, and physics.
